intro.zh: 采集与审核简报已发布，本期未收录新论文。发布前采集与审核记录：北京时间14:24–14:29实际尝试了全部12路信源。HF今日榜已开放，观察到6篇，逐项范围审查均未发现Harness自进化证据；不代表全天不会再有新成员。同时核对11/11完整榜39篇与11/10的39篇，后者比昨日快照增加2个晚到成员。全来源去重新发现65项（58篇论文、7篇官方文章）；三轮审查支持6项限定纳入、59项排除，无新增未决范围项。EmoHarness按11/10推荐日补刊，RoboScript复核原文后按新增观察到的11/11推荐日补刊，审核日均为11/12。LASER、SAT、RoboACE、FGSE与NCP按较早来源日期列入历史补录审核，不冒充今天新论文；NCP仅收控制层准入框架和负结果，实际候选全拒绝，活动策略未变。ReTrace虽然有反馈修复和跨输入复用，但产物是替代Agent的SOP任务程序，不计自身Harness。三路arXiv查询成功、窗口内为0；五路RSS返回54条窗口记录；GitHub检查13个仓库、窗口内release为0。S2引文取得318条窗口记录（285个ID），分页受本次时间窗限制，作者源被429限流；未取得覆盖仍为未知。9项历史正文外部阻塞共重试18次，均未恢复所需正文。74条作者/comments元数据已按官方来源核实补齐，保留原科学字段、first_seen和审核；历史版本待审单继续逐项记录。RoboScript的HF时间戳与arXiv原日期不一致、旧URL候选含TeX尾巴等数据疑点仅报告。新增付费生成请求为0。本期是实际采集时点的状态简报，未收录今天新论文。
intro.en: Collection and review bulletin published; no new papers were included. Collection and review record before publication: All 12 sources were attempted at 14:24–14:29 Asia/Shanghai. Today’s HF board was available with six papers, none meeting the Harness self-evolution criterion in item-level scope review; later additions remain possible. The complete Nov 11 and refreshed Nov 10 boards each contained 39 papers, with two late Nov 10 members. Across sources, 65 new identities (58 papers and seven official articles) received three-round review: six narrowly qualify and 59 are excluded, with no new unresolved scope cases. EmoHarness is assigned to its Nov 10 recommendation date, and RoboScript is assigned to the newly observed Nov 11 recommendation date after rechecking its original evidence; both are reviewed on Nov 12. LASER, SAT, RoboACE, FGSE and NCP enter historical-backlog review under their older source dates, not today’s new-paper count. NCP qualifies only as a control-rule admission framework and negative result: all actual candidates were rejected and the active policy did not change. ReTrace has real repair feedback and reuse, but produces an SOP task program replacing the agent rather than revising its own Harness. Three arXiv searches returned no window records; five RSS feeds returned 54; checks of 13 GitHub repositories found no window releases. S2 citations yielded 318 window records covering 285 identities, with traversal stopped at the time bound before all pages were read; the author source was rate-limited. Uncollected coverage remains unknown. Eighteen retries for nine older externally blocked bodies recovered none. Seventy-four author/comment metadata patches were verified against official sources while preserving scientific fields, first_seen and prior decisions. Version-review work remains individually recorded. Timestamp disagreements for RoboScript and TeX-tainted URL proposals are reported without changing source facts. New paid generation requests: zero. This is a collection-time status bulletin, with no new papers included today.
